response.overview: In 2022 a reviewer said that Milo Edwards was 'unsentimental' and sent him on a mission to discover what sentimentality is. What resulted was a show about life, death, loss, and Kwik Fit Tyre & Exhaust Centres. Sentimental has had a long journey, from a sell-out 5 star run at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe in 2023, racking up the NextUp nomination for ‘Best Show’ and receiving a nomination for ‘Best Show’ at Leicester Comedy Festival in 2024, the show went on to tour the UK, Ireland, Europe and Australia, before being taped at Underbelly Boulevard in London's Soho in September 2025.
response.title: Milo Edwards: Sentimental Live
